name: Air Fryer Pumpkin Donut Holes
recipeIngredient: 1/3 c. (71 g) packed light brown sugar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large microwave-safe bowl, microwave 5 Tbsp. butter in 15-second increments until melted. Let cool slightly.
Add egg, pumpkin puree, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, nutmeg, and 1/2 tsp. cinnamon and whisk until combined. Add flour and fold just until combined.

Preheat an air fryer to 350° for 5 minutes. Scoop 1 Tbsp. batter into muffin liners (about 20 g each). Working in batches of 8, fry until risen, cracked, and lightly browned on top, 7 to 9 minutes (depending on your air fryer). Using tongs, transfer to a wire rack and let cool in liners for 2 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a wide, shallow heatproof dish, microwave remaining 6 Tbsp. butter in 15-second increments until melted. In another wide, shallow dish, whisk granulated sugar and remaining 3 tsp. cinnamon.

Working one at a time, roll donuts in melted butter, then immediately in cinnamon sugar. Return to wire rack and let cool completely. Repeat with remaining batter, reusing liners as necessary (no need to wash between batches!).
